**q25** — Engine: Google CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`), wrapped by the in-repo `internal/filter` package (`internal/filter/engine.go:14-27` env/parse, `internal/filter/schema.go` field schema, `internal/filter/ir.go` condition tree, `internal/filter/render.go` SQL renderer). Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled to a dialect-agnostic `Condition` IR, then `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, dialect, &where, &args)` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`) renders it to a parameterized SQL fragment for the requested `DialectName` (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectMySQL`/`DialectPostgres`, `internal/filter/schema.go:14-16`), which each driver appends to its WHERE clause — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`.

**q26** — `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (the memo itself plus its comment memos, recursively), and `memo_share` — the latter by the DB-level `FOREIGN KEY (memo_id) REFERENCES memo(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:102-110`). `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:546`) but are **not** deleted.

**q27** — Mechanism: the built `web/dist` output is compiled into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo static middleware plus an SPA (index.html) fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed) and `:41-61` (`FrontendService.Serve`), invoked from `server/server.go:73`.

**q28**
```
s3presign Runner — server/runner/s3presign/runner.go: RunOnce immediately at startup (server/server.go:163) + time.Ticker every 12h (runner.go:27-30); started in Server.startBackgroundRunners (server/server.go:153-172)
webhook async dispatch workers — internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54: 4 goroutines started by package init(), driven by the asyncPostQueue channel (not a timer)
```
Unused-infra notes: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron-expression job scheduler, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `middleware.go`) is **not** referenced anywhere outside its own package/tests — the server never uses it. Also `server/runner/memopayload` lives under `server/runner/` but is not a background runner; it is called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447`.

**q29** — Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:148-171`, installed on the Connect transport (`web/src/connect.ts:175-180`). Tokens it manages: a JWT **access token** (`Authorization: Bearer …`, stored/refreshed via `web/src/auth-state.ts`, with proactive expiry refresh and 401-retry) and a **refresh token** held in an HTTP-only cookie sent via `credentials: "include"` (`web/src/connect.ts:57-63`; cookie built server-side in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go:224-226`). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/token.go` `ParseAccessTokenV2`/`ParseRefreshToken`, `server/auth/authenticator.go` incl. PAT auth), invoked through `Authorizer` in `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` for both the Connect interceptor and the gRPC-gateway middleware (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:67-92`).
